name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Miraidon ex)

releases.name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Miraidon ex)

description.text: The Master Strategy Deck Building Set (大师战略卡组构筑套装) Miraidon ex is a box for players who want to start battling quickly and keep improving a deck, one of three released on 16 January 2026 with the Charizard ex, Gardevoir ex and Miraidon ex decks. It holds a ready-built 60-card Miraidon ex deck, with Miraidon ex, Iron Hands ex and Raikou V among its Pokémon and Electric Generator, Rescue Board and Forest Seal Stone among its Trainers. Pokémon China pitched it at players who believe speed is unbeatable and want to crush the opponent at lightning speed. With it come a sheet on how the deck plays, a 15-card modification pack and a guide to changing the deck, four 20-card Blade Awakening packs to change it further, a set of 64 card sleeves in one of eight designs at random, a Miraidon deck box with two dividers, a coin die, six metal damage-counter dice and an acrylic VSTAR marker and Poison and Burn markers. Its cards are numbered out of 28.

sources.title: Pokémon China: The Master Strategy Deck Building Sets: Charizard ex, Gardevoir ex and Miraidon ex (25 December 2025)
